description: Goals a customer can choose; each needs every group of features, and any one feature satisfies a group. The advisor reads this with features.json and bundles.json.

goals.name: Phishing-resistant sign-in enforced
goals.what: Require passkeys or keys through Conditional Access authentication strengths, for administrators first.

goals.name: Risky sign-ins challenged, compromised accounts contained
goals.what: Sign-in risk and user risk policies from Identity Protection.

goals.name: Administrator roles just in time
goals.what: Privileged Identity Management: eligible roles activated with MFA, approval and a time limit.

goals.name: Only compliant devices reach company data
goals.what: Intune compliance with Conditional Access requiring a compliant device.

goals.name: A device under attack loses access
goals.what: Defender reports device risk to Intune, compliance acts on it, Conditional Access requires compliance.

goals.name: Endpoint detection and automated response
goals.what: EDR with automated investigation and remediation, vulnerability management.

goals.name: Phishing and malware stopped in mail, Teams and Office
goals.what: Safe Links, Safe Attachments and impersonation protection.

goals.name: Attack simulation training
goals.what: Simulated phishing with training for the people who click.

goals.name: Sensitive files labelled and encrypted
goals.what: Sensitivity labels people apply, with encryption on the top tier.

goals.name: Sensitive data labelled automatically
goals.what: Auto-labelling policies for the information types that matter.

goals.name: Data loss prevention on devices
goals.what: Endpoint DLP on Windows and macOS.

goals.name: Data loss prevention in Teams
goals.what: DLP policies over Teams chats and channels.

goals.name: Copilot cannot surface what was overshared
goals.what: Oversharing reports and restricted access, labels, and DLP for Copilot.

goals.name: Oversharing found and closed
goals.what: Data access governance reports, restricted access control and site access reviews.

goals.name: Insider risk monitored
goals.what: Insider Risk Management policies, connected to HR for leavers.

goals.name: A year of audit history for investigations
goals.what: Audit (Premium) retention and high-value events.

goals.name: Access reviewed on a schedule
goals.what: Recurring access reviews of privileged roles, guests and groups.

goals.name: Joiners, movers and leavers automated
goals.what: Lifecycle workflows driven by HR data.

goals.name: Attacks on on-premises AD detected
goals.what: Defender for Identity sensors on the domain controllers.

goals.name: Shadow IT discovered and governed
goals.what: Defender for Cloud Apps discovery, session controls and app governance.

goals.name: Private apps without a VPN
goals.what: Entra Private Access with Conditional Access on each app.

goals.name: Internet traffic filtered and governed
goals.what: Entra Internet Access web content filtering.

goals.name: Users run as standard users, elevation on request
goals.what: Endpoint Privilege Management.
